children: Paramount has reached a settlement with California and several other states that sued over a proposed $81bn merger with Warner Bros Discovery

, the California attorney general announced Monday, clearing the way to consolidate some of Hollywood’s most recognizable TV networks and studios under one owner. Though the merger was approved by the justice department in June, a coalition of 12 states, led by California, had sued over concerns that combining two of the five last legacy studios in Hollywood would “extinguish competition” and lead to fewer movies in theatres and on streaming platforms. - Guardian

The Bank of England’s new office in Leeds is owned by a Monaco-based Reform UK donor, filings show. Bank officials confirmed on Monday that it had signed a three-year lease for Capitol House in Bond Court, a property owned by Evans Property Group. Electoral Commission records show that an arm of Evans Property Group donated £200,000 to Nigel Farage’s party before the 2024 general election. Evans Property Group was founded by the late Michael Evans, who died in Monaco in November 2023. – Telegraph

Sir Nick Clegg stands to make as much as $40m (£30m) from the Wall Street flotation of an AI company he joined six months ago. The former deputy prime minister owns more than 900,000 shares in Nscale, a British data centre company, thanks to his role as a member of its board. Nscale said last week it had filed for an initial public offering
on the New York Stock Exchange. Sir Nick, 59, owns 917,460 shares in the company, roughly 0.12pc of its existing stock. – Telegraph

The City regulator is suing a major promoter of loan note investments in an attempt to return money to investors, its most forceful attempt to tackle a sector that has put billions of pounds of consumer funds at risk. The Financial Conduct Authority has begun High Court proceedings against Osborne Baldwin, which trades as Hunter Jones, a property investment firm claiming to have raised more than £300 million. – The Times
